title: Centralized Web Audio API harmonic synthesizer: 9 distinct pentatonic crystal chime frequencies mapped to the 9 matrix sectors, deep sub-bass lock thuds on placement, triumphant chord fanfare on Triad Victory, and a suspended chord resolve on Equilibrium Deadlock.
author_role: Principal Client & UI Architect (Canvas 2D rendering, HUD overlays, visual feedback)
summary: Implement a procedural Web Audio API harmonic sound engine triggering sector-specific pentatonic chime resonances, sub-bass sector impacts, and chord resolutions.
technical_specification: Initialize `window.AudioContext` on first user interaction under `state.audioCtx`. Map sectors 0-8 to pentatonic frequencies: `[261.63, 293.66, 329.63, 392.00, 440.00, 523.25, 587.33, 659.25, 783.99]` Hz. On placement in sector `i`, instantiate an oscillator at `freq[i]` with exponential decay (`tau = 0.4s`) and a 55Hz sub-bass sine wave decaying over 0.25s. On `TRIAD_VICTORY`, trigger a triumphant major chord triad `[freq[a], freq[b], freq[c]]` with a 1.2s shimmer envelope. On `EQUILIBRIUM_DEADLOCK`, trigger a suspended 4th chord resolve decaying over 1.6s. All audio nodes connect through a master limiter gain node at 0.35 gain.
acceptance_criteria: Every matrix inscription emits both a 55Hz sub-bass thud and sector-mapped crystal chime without audio clipping.
Collinear Triad victory triggers a three-note resonant harmonic chord, while equilibrium deadlock emits a resolving sus4 chord.
